social.og_description: Public overview of the WinProx REST API (Sanctum), webhooks and Corporate availability.

title: WinProx REST API & webhooks
lead: Integrate issues, tasks, locations, units, teams, workers and ESG measurements via a versioned REST API under /api/v1. Outbound webhooks notify your systems of domain events.

overview.title: Overview
overview.body: The API is JSON in/out, tenant-scoped via the user token, with consistent response envelopes and pagination on lists. Rate limit: 60 requests per minute per token.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.body: Use Laravel Sanctum personal access tokens as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.
items: Tokens with abilities (least privilege), e.g. issues:read, tasks:update, webhooks:manage
API access requires Corporate (or explicit trial API enablement)

items.name: Issues & tasks
items.text: Create/read/approve issues; create, start, complete and update tasks.

items.name: Locations, units, teams, workers
items.text: Read your facility structure and field teams.

items.name: ESG measurements
items.text: Record measurements via esg:create where the module is enabled.

items.name: IoT Connect (gateway)
items.text: Sensor events via gateway token to /api/v1/iot/events (Facility + Corporate; full Sanctum API not required).

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.body: Register per-tenant endpoints for events such as issue.created, issue.approved, task.created/started/completed. Delivery is queued, with HMAC signature, retries and a delivery log.

access.title: How to get access
access.body: On Corporate you manage API tokens and webhooks under Settings in the workspace. Full technical docs are available in-app for customers with API access. Contact us for trial API or integration questions.
